searchText: Hey guys, i am unable to find Eth for the rinkeyby testnet network, can someone recommend a solution? Did you try faucet? https://faucet.rinkeby.io/ yea, i tried all 5 i found, all i was able to get is 0.01 which does not give me enough to deploy contracts But did you follow the instructions for faucet and make a tweet with the ETH address you want the Rinkeby ETH dpeosited to? yea i posted the address on my twitter, and pasted the link into the faucet websie idea? The minimum is 3. How long ago did you submit the request? an hour ago i need to wait the 7 hours? I can send you some, what's your address? No, that's the time limit before you can request again. 0x738EaB407602469cd8fE84Ce22Eb95882d098B7c thank you so much! oh got it Sent you 3 Rinkeby ETH i just saw! thank you so much1 Appreciate it 🙂 I wonder if faucet is broken, doesn't seem to be operating correctly. And no worries. Hmm, getting "insufficient funds for gas * price + value" error on faucet. At least, that was my understanding. Could be wrong on that.
